title: Threatening Letter - Mr. Tsu S Yi

page_data.en:
Copy for Sp. Branch
（印：POLICE 367 13 9/40）

2005/40.
"B"
B'Well
September 8th., 40.
2nd.
13.

As per instructions of D.D.O. "B", a detective has been posted in the vicinity of the complainant's premises.

A copy of this report has now been forwarded to Special Branch.

The complainant Mr. Tsu S Yi was interviewed on the morning of 6/9/40. He states he can give no reason whatsoever for the letter being addressed to him, and is inclined to make light of the matter. He is on good terms with his employees and servants; has no political connections, and his business connections are good.

Specimens of the handwriting of the complainant's employees have been obtained, and are attached herewith for examination.

（批：R.S.H 9/9.）
（批：count 7/9）
（批：hug 9/9）

T.B. Greenfield

送特别处副本
（印：POLICE 367 13 9/40）

2005/40.
“B”
B'Well
1940年9月8日。
第2项。
13.

遵照“B”区副总监指令，已派一名侦探在报案人住所附近蹲守。

本报告副本现已送交特别处。

报案人朱士义（Tsu S Yi）先生于1940年9月6日上午接受问询。他表示完全不知此信为何寄给他本人，并倾向于对此事不予重视。他与雇员及仆役关系良好；无任何政治关联，且商业往来信誉良好。

已获取报案人雇员的笔迹样本，随附供查验。

（批注：R.S.H 9/9.）
（批注：count 7/9）
（批注：hug 9/9）

T.B. Greenfield

page_data.en:
COPY OF B'WELL S.I.P.2005/40 - THREATENING LETTER
At 2.20 p.m. 4-9-40 the informant Zung Tsung Koh (陳曾錦), accountant, employed by the Asia Union Engineering Corporation, 475 Seymour Road, and living at 177 Rue Brenier Montmorand, F.C., brought to the Station a threatening letter which had been sent by Post to his master Mr. S.Y. Tsu (朱植楷), manager of the Asia Union Engineering Corporation.
The letter, received at 10,a.m. 4-9-40, written in red ink on a piece of brown paper, and enclosed in a cheap envelope, was posted at Bubbling Well Post Office.
The writer, who signs himself "Wong (王)", says that Mr. Tsu's services are requested by the Nanking Government, and he is advised to leave within one week. Failing this, the writer concludes, Mr. Tsu and his family will be in danger.
The informant says that Mr. Tsu is of the opinion that the letter was probably written by a dissatisfied workman. He cannot name any particular person.
Mr. Tsu cannot at present be located, but will be questioned at the first opportunity.
The letter, together with a translation, is attached.
(sd) H.E. Greenfield, D.S.37.

TRANSLATION OF LETTER
Mr. S Yi;
On instructions of the Central, you have been appointed some high position in the Nanking High Section. Now I give you one week to come to Nanking, failing which, you and your family will have to eat "eggs", "moon-cake" or "green-bean soup".
Becareful when you go out.
From Wong X I.
page_data.zh:
B'Well 上海公共租界工部局警务处 2005/40号副本 - 恐吓信
1940年9月4日下午2时20分，线人陈曾锦（Zung Tsung Koh），会计师，受雇于西摩路475号亚洲联合工程公司，居住于法租界勃朗宁蒙莫朗路177号，向警局提交了一封通过邮政寄给其雇主、亚洲联合工程公司经理朱植楷（S.Y. Tsu）先生的恐吓信。
该信于1940年9月4日上午10时收到，用红墨水写在一张棕色纸上，装在一个廉价信封内，从静安寺邮局寄出。
写信人自署“王（Wong）”，称南京政府征召朱先生任职，劝其于一周内离开。否则，写信人 concluding 道，朱先生及其家人将面临危险。
线人称，朱先生认为此信可能是一名不满的工人所写。他无法指认任何特定人员。
目前无法找到朱先生，但将在第一时间对其进行问询。
该信连同译文一并附后。
（签名）H.E. Greenfield，警司37号。

信件译文
朱士义先生：
奉中央指令，你已被任命为南京高层部门某高级职位。现限你一周内前往南京，否则，你和你的家人就得吃“鸡蛋”、“月饼”或“绿豆汤”。
外出时小心。
王 X I 启
